name: ticketdesk
description: 客服工单协作平台：任务入口。所有命令在 Windows、macOS、Linux 上相同。

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && go -C backend mod download
scripts.build: go -C backend build ./... && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.db:psql: docker-compose exec db psql -U ticketdesk -d ticketdesk
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run migrate && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test:race: docker-compose --profile test run --rm gotest go test -race -tags integration -p 1 -count=1 ./...
scripts.check: go -C backend build ./... && go -C backend vet ./... && node scripts/check-fmt.mjs && npm run test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
